record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly set hidden/embedding width to 192, dropout to 0.2 and Adam learning rate to 7e-4. Greater recurrent capacity may distinguish heterogeneous interests, while stronger dropout and smaller updates constrain overfitting and instability. Preserve tied unit-normalized embeddings, one GRU layer, current readout, scoring, loss, sampling and other settings. Match predictor dimensions and retain the 200-epoch cap and 200 batches per epoch.

category_rationales.rationale: Jointly increase embedding/GRU width to 192, raise dropout to 0.2, and reduce Adam learning rate to 7e-4 across all four datasets. Extra capacity may distinguish heterogeneous interests, while stronger regularization and smaller updates constrain overfitting. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor loading propagate the width consistently. Preserve the current readout, tied embeddings, loss, single-model routing, and training limits.
